ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: The dragonfly nymph is consumed by which of the following?
ready1_open_rewrite.title: Dataset Open Question

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The food-web diagram shows several organisms connected by green arrows. The label 'Dragonfly nymph' is in the center. Above it is a fish labeled 'Brown trout.' A green arrow starts at the dragonfly nymph and points upward toward the brown trout. Reasoning: In this food web, arrows point from the organism being eaten to the organism that consumes it. Since the arrow goes from the dragonfly nymph to the brown trout, the dragonfly nymph is consumed by the brown trout.
